info.name: Numark NS6
info.author: maurojuniorr
info.description: 4 channel MIDI Mapping for Numark NS6

option.label: Start Time
option.description: Adjusts how quickly a deck accelerates when PLAY is pressed while paused. Zero starts instantly; higher values make the soft start faster. After a jog release, the mapping follows the platter's actual remaining movement and returns to normal playback when that movement stops.

control.description: handles deck assignment led feedback right
handles deck assignment led feedback left
NS6 X-Fader slope knob controls the Mixxx crossfader curve
NS6 MASTER knob: CC 67 controls Mixxx Master volume
NS6 headphone level knob: CC 66 controls Mixxx headphone volume
NS6 headphone CUE/MIX knob: CC 18 MSB
NS6 headphone CUE/MIX knob: CC 50 LSB
